_why: Kernel routes the assistant cannot reach. A WORKLIST, not an allowance: it may only shrink. Each is a capability a person has and Cobb does not, which is how he came to print a stage direction instead of grouping two nav sections. Give one an action (// AI-ACTION: <id>) or say why it should never have a door (// AI-REACH: <reason>), then delete its line. A NEW kernel route cannot be added here: it says which it is on the day it is written.
